title: Sorcerer at the Gate
description: A hooded sorcerer in a dark blue cloak stands before a massive iron portcullis set into an ancient stone castle wall. The figure raises a hand emitting bright purple magical energy that strikes the gate, surrounded by icy blue spikes, chains, and overgrown vines under a dramatic twilight sky.
